summary: Voyage AI pricing advertises first-token free allowances per account: the current tables list 200M for voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4, voyage-code-4, rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite; 50M for voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2; and 200M text tokens plus 150B pixels for current multimodal models. However, prose above the tables still names voyage-code-3, voyage-multilingual-2 and older rerank-2/2.5 families, while the older-models table places those same legacy models under “we do not offer free tokens for them.” The conflict therefore extends beyond the code-3/code-4 mismatch already recorded. Do not assume the prose gives free legacy-model usage: confirm the exact model and applicable remaining allowance with Voyage before calling. Free credits exclude Batch API usage, which is billed separately. No recurring allowance, enrollment deadline or inferred policy-change date is established.
claim_steps: Sign up for a Voyage AI account and create an API key in the dashboard.

Check the exact model against current pricing tables and your dashboard before calling. The page conflicts on code-3, multilingual-2 and older rerank-2/2.5 models; ask Voyage which terms apply rather than assuming those models are free.
Use eligible embeddings/rerank endpoints within the confirmed account allowance. Do not use Batch API expecting free credits; it bills separately.

social_proof.title: Pricing — Voyage AI documentation
social_proof.text: The first 200 million tokens for voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4 ... are free for every account. Free token credits do not apply to Batch API usage.
